Class Attack

java.lang.Object
models.bugemon.Attack
public class Attack extends Object
Represents an attack that a Bugémon can use during a fight. An attack has a name, type, description, power and optional effects. Instances of this class are loaded from the game data (JSON) and are used by Bugémon to inflict damage during battles.
